title: Round 2 of the JA Joomla j6 slot contracts (r2b): JA Titan, JA Rights, JA Stark and JA Fresco, not ready in round 1, wear a design system from their 1.0.1 re-release
steps: S1: node --test test/tokenize.test.mjs test/slot.test.mjs test/cms.test.mjs (cwd packages/design/tracy-ds-slot).

S2: read templates/joomla-ja-{titan,rights,stark,fresco}.json through loadContract; tokenize a Titan dark-mode block with its varRoles and a Stark style-template body rule with its t4Placeholders; build JA Rights' Moxie module sheet (joomlaSlot).
S3: apps/tracy-web/src/lib/ds-slot.js contractFor(templateKeyOf({platform:'joomla', template:'ja_<name>'}), {key:'quickstart/ja-<name>/j6', version}) for each, at 1.0.1 and at 1.0.0.

S4: node packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/scripts/pass-joomla.mjs ja-fresco --port 53661 --cdp 9871 --evidence <tmp> (release restored in Docker, stylesheets tokenized, Moxie, MotherDuck, Toggl Track and Apple worn, cleared, stand removed).
expect: S1: every test passes, none skipped.

S2: all four ready, minVersion {'quickstart/ja-<name>/j6': '1.0.1'}, readyNote naming tasks/evidence/ds-contracts-r2b-2026-10-11/templates/ja-<name>-j6 (or, for a template re-measured since, a tasks/evidence/ds-remeasure-*/ds-reverify-* folder of it that exists, as the later pass rewrote the readyNote on 11-12/10/2026); Titan's tokenScope includes body.dark-active and '.dark-active{--t4-gray-900:#F8F8F8;--t4-gray-100:#1B1B1B}' tokenizes to var(--ds-c-fg-2, #F8F8F8) and var(--ds-c-surface, #1B1B1B); Stark's 'body{background-color:__color_white;color:__body_text_color}' tokenizes to var(--ds-c-bg, __color_white) and var(--ds-c-fg, __body_text_color), no t4SiteCss; Rights' sheet has color:var(--ds-c-accent-on)!important and a :where(.item-align-center,.t4-footer,.bg-white,.bg-dark,.bg-purple) rule; Fresco keeps .t4-hero and .acm-features.
S4: verdicts 12/12, controls 0,0,0,0, no text under 4.5:1 worse than the template's own, lowest page share following ≥ 0.5.

selectors.contracts: packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/templates/joomla-ja-{titan,rights,stark,fresco}.json ready, minVersion, tokenScope, varRoles, t4Placeholders, keepScopes, keepDefaultsYield, buttonTextImportant

evidence: tasks/evidence/ds-contracts-r2b-2026-10-11/README.md: each template measured on 1.0.0 tokenized in place and on its 1.0.1 build stood up from its own zip; desktop and phone screenshots checked by eye.
fence: which r2b templates are offered and the contract fields and library options that made them pass; not the release upload (RELEASE-DS-R2B.sh, a person runs it)
